title: Get up to $400 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until Friday
summary: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

title: Trump’s DOJ gains oversight of OpenAI’s green-card employee sponsorships
summary: The DOJ alleged that OpenAI did not meaningful attempt to hire U.S. citizens before seeking permanent residence for Visa-holding employees.

title: How Lightspeed found its newest hire … via Instagram DM
summary: Lightspeed partners Josh Machiz and Claire Zau stopped by the Equity studio to talk about the strategies behind their growing social media presence and their podcast, Lightwork.

title: Klaviyo acquires Elias Torres’ Agency in full-circle reunion for tech founders
summary: The serial entrepreneur joins the e-commerce company as CPO to lead its AI agents.

title: Meet the eight startups pitching at Startup Battlefield Australia
summary: The applications are in, and the TechCrunch Startup Battlefield team made their decisions!

title: Hark previews its browser use agent for completing tasks
summary: Hark claims that its browser use agent is faster and cheaper than competition.

title: Robinhood to list a fund that lets anyone back Y Combinator startups
summary: Robinhood's latest financial instrument intends to let any retail investor feel like they, too, can make money by backing Y Combinator startups.

title: Saudi Aramco backs India’s Mitti Labs to make Asia’s rice farming more water-resilient
summary: Mitti Labs plans to expand beyond India and enter the Philippines and Indonesia while growing its carbon credits and agricultural data business.

title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
summary: WindBorne Systems has raised a $37 million Series B round to scale its weather balloons and AI forecasts.

title: How to get the best hotel deals for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: We’ve partnered with hotels around Moscone West during Disrupt, taking place October 13 to 15, to secure the best prices available for attendees.

title: Meet Wrinkles, an app that uncovers the hidden stories of the places around you
summary: Wrinkles, available on both iOS and Android, essentially acts as an AI-powered audio tour guide that reveals hidden history and local stories.

title: Host a Side Event during TechCrunch Founder Summit Week in Boston
summary: Want to tap into the energy of 1,100+ startup founders, investors, and tech leaders descending on Boston for the Founder Summit 2026 on June 9? Host your own Side Event during “Founder Summit Week,” happening June 4-10!

title: Bending Spoons to buy Airtable for $1.28B
summary: At its peak in 2021, Airtable was valued at over $11 billion, but earlier this year, its shares were said to be trading on the secondary markets at a valuation of $4 billion.

title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
summary: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step toward decoupling apps from models.

title: Design Arena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
summary: Design Arena is used by 5.3 million people around the world, providing critical human evaluations to frontier labs.

title: Outernet turns your saved posts into real-world adventures
summary: Founded by the creators of viral offline events like San Francisco’s citywide scavenger hunt Pursuit, Outernet's app helps users save places and events they discover online, then nudges them to actually go.

title: Sequoia’s Shaun Maguire leads $1B round for nuclear startup Valar Atomics
summary: Valar Atomics raised $1 billion at a $6 billion valuation after signing a development deal with Nvidia in June.

title: Base Power raises another $1B to save the grid using backyard batteries
summary: Base Power’s $1 billion round will help the startup ramp production of its home batteries.

title: Horizon3 hits $2 billion valuation with $250M Series E as AI threats escalate
summary: Cybersecurity startup Horizon3 raised $250 million at a $2 billion valuation as companies want continuous, AI-powered security validation instead of annual pen testing.

title: Silicon Valley loves young founders. Until it doesn’t.
summary: AI tools have democratized the opportunity to build, shortening the timelines of success and enabling more young people to start successful companies without stepping foot inside a Big Tech company.
